name: Rachel Fleischman, LCSW
reason: Re-checked under the 12 Nov rule (rachelfleischman.com, 12 Nov 2026): wellbeing wording is no longer a bar, but her site presents her as a San Francisco psychotherapist (founder of Bliss Counseling) and a keynote speaker whose offering is booked talks and corporate wellness workshops (Dance Your Bliss, Permission to Pause, The Science of Sleep). Once therapy and booked speaking are set aside, her own public programme is two one-hour Dance Your Bliss movement classes at ODC (6 Dec 2026, free hybrid; 14 Feb 2027), a presenter week at Rancho La Puerta (a hub where she is a visiting presenter) and a book not yet published; the Omega retreat on her home page (25 Sept to 2 Oct, no year given) appears to be the one just past. Too little contemplative teaching of her own for a full page. Email dancingyourbliss@gmail.com is published on /contact if the owner wants her anyway.
